Denis "electroNic" Sharipov (formerly stylized as electronic) (born September 2, 1998) is a Russian professional Counter-Strike 2 player and a former Counter-Strike: Global Offensive player currently playing for BC.Game. electroNic is best known for his time at Natus Vincere and his partnership with s1mple from 2017 to 2023.

In December of 2022, electroNic requested for Liquipedia to denote that he choose not to represent Russia, with a further request to return to his original representation being received at the end of March 2024.
